## claude.ai Higgsfield
Use generate_image and generate_video as the core tools for image and video creation. Use virality_predictor when the user asks to predict video virality or analyze engagement, attention, audience response, retention risk, hook strength, or creative performance. ## pencil
The Pencil MCP server is the editor for reading and writing to .pen files and gives you tools to be an expert design generator and validator specifically for web and mobile applications and websites.

- IMPORTANT: The contents of the .pen files are encrypted and can be only access via the "pencil" MCP tools. DO NOT use "Read" or "Grep" tools to read contents of .pen files.
- IMPORTANT: Make sure to ONLY use the "pencil" MCP tools when reading or searching contents of .pen files (batch_get) and making changes inside .pen files (batch_design).
- IMPORTANT: Always follow the tool definitions and formats for the "pencil" MCP tools.

Available tools:
- "get_editor_state({ include_schema })": Start with this tool if you are unaware of the current editor state. Use this tool to determine in the beginning of a task, to understand what is the currently active .pen file you want to work on and the current user selection in it and other essential context information.
- "open_document(filePathOrNew)": When there is no active editor opened, pass 'new' to create an empty .pen file or if the user explicitly ask to open a specific .pen file use its path to open it.
- "get_guidelines(category?, name?, params?)": Load guides and styles for working with .pen files.
- "batch_get(patterns, nodeIds)": Retrieve nodes by searching for matching patterns or by reading node ids in batches. Use this for discovering and understand .pen files.
- "batch_design(operations)": Use it when designing with .pen files to execute multiple insert/copy/update/replace/move/delete/image operations in a single call. IMPORTANT: MAKE SURE TO FOLLOW THE OPERATION SYNTAX DEFINED IN THE TOOL'S DESCRIPTION. Aim for maximum 25 operations per call—enough to make meaningful progress without overwhelming the system. Available operations (used as a small script where every line a single operation call):
	- Insert: foo=I("parent", { ... })
	- Copy: baz=C("nodeid", "parent", { ...})
	- Replace: foo2=R("nodeid1/nodeid2", {...})
	- Update: U(foo+"/nodeid", {...})

4	type: project
5	---
6	
7	## What It Is
8	An internal web app for Digital Resource (~90–100 employees) to manage and self-serve their email signatures. Admins manage a Master Template (company-wide settings) and individual employee records. Employees visit a personal URL to copy their signature.
9	
10	## Live URLs
11	- **Production (Railway):** https://email-signature-app-production.up.railway.app/
12	- **Custom domain (pending full SSL):** https://signatures.yourdigitalresource.com
13	- **Local dev:** http://localhost:3000
14	
15	## Project Location
16	- **Local files:** `/Users/richardvargas/claude-projects/Email Signature App/`
17	- **GitHub:** Connected to Railway for auto-deploy (push to main = auto-deploy)
18	
19	## Stack
20	- Node.js + Express
21	- SQLite via `better-sqlite3`
22	- Multer for image uploads
23	- Vanilla JS frontend (no frameworks — keep it that way)
24	- Railway PaaS hosting with persistent volume at `/app/data`
25	- Volume covers both `signatures.db` and `uploads/` folder
26	
27	## Key Files
28	| File | Purpose |
29	|------|---------|
30	| `server.js` | Express server, all API routes, DB setup, migration columns |
31	| `public/index.html` | Dashboard — employee list, master template card, admin auth |
32	| `public/edit.html` | Split-pane signature editor |
33	| `public/signature.html` | Employee-facing page to copy their signature |
34	| `public/sig-builder.js` | Shared signature HTML builder (used by all three pages) |
35	| `public/dr-logo.png` | DR dark mode logo (local file, uploaded to Railway) |
36	| `data/signatures.db` | SQLite database (on Railway persistent volume) |
37	| `data/uploads/` | Uploaded images (photos, banners, logos) |
38	
39	## Database
40	- **Table: employees** — all employee fields including styling (name_font, label_color, etc.)
41	- **Table: settings** — company-wide master template settings + social icon rows (10 slots)
42	- Migration pattern: `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` with try/catch for idempotency
43	- Admin password stored in settings table (key: `admin_password`)
44	
45	## Auth
46	- In-memory session tokens (`adminSessions` Set in server.js)
47	- Token stored in `sessionStorage` on client as `adminToken`
48	- Passed via `x-admin-token` header on all admin requests
49	
50	## Design System (DR Brand)
51	- **Font:** Inter Tight (Google Fonts) — weights 400/600/700/800
52	- **Colors:** Navy `#010F37`, Lime `#D5DE23`, Blue `#26A9E1`, Orange `#F6931E`, Gray `#404041`

54	- **Light mode default** with dark mode toggle (🌙/☀️), persists via `localStorage` key `dr-theme`
55	- **Primary CTA:** Lime pill buttons (`#D5DE23` bg, `#010F37` text, `border-radius: 999px`)
56	- **Cards:** White surface, lime top-border (`border-top: 3px solid #D5DE23`)
57	- **Table header:** Navy bg with white text
58	- **Toast:** Navy pill with lime left-border accent
59	- **Dark mode:** Navy grid texture background, dark surfaces (`#0c1840`)
60

62	- **Port:** 8080 (set via PORT env variable)
63	- **Volume:** `/app/data` — single volume covering DB + uploads
64	- **Custom domain:** `signatures.yourdigitalresource.com`

type: project
---

## What It Is
An internal web app for Digital Resource (~90–100 employees) to manage and self-serve their email signatures. Admins manage a Master Template (company-wide settings) and individual employee records. Employees visit a personal URL to copy their signature.

## Live URLs
- **Production (Railway):** https://email-signature-app-production.up.railway.app/
- **Custom domain (pending full SSL):** https://signatures.yourdigitalresource.com
- **Local dev:** http://localhost:3000

## Project Location
- **Local files:** `/Users/richardvargas/claude-projects/Email Signature App/`
- **GitHub:** Connected to Railway for auto-deploy (push to main = auto-deploy)

## Stack
- Node.js + Express
- SQLite via `better-sqlite3`
- Multer for image uploads
- Vanilla JS frontend (no frameworks — keep it that way)
- Railway PaaS hosting with persistent volume at `/app/data`
- Volume covers both `signatures.db` and `uploads/` folder

## Key Files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `server.js` | Express server, all API routes, DB setup, migration columns |
| `public/index.html` | Dashboard — employee list, master template card, admin auth |
| `public/edit.html` | Split-pane signature editor |
| `public/signature.html` | Employee-facing page to copy their signature |
| `public/sig-builder.js` | Shared signature HTML builder (used by all three pages) |
| `public/dr-logo.png` | DR dark mode logo (local file, uploaded to Railway) |
| `data/signatures.db` | SQLite database (on Railway persistent volume) |
| `data/uploads/` | Uploaded images (photos, banners, logos) |

## Database
- **Table: employees** — all employee fields including styling (name_font, label_color, etc.)
- **Table: settings** — company-wide master template settings + social icon rows (10 slots)
- Migration pattern: `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` with try/catch for idempotency
- Admin password stored in settings table (key: `admin_password`)

## Auth
- In-memory session tokens (`adminSessions` Set in server.js)
- Token stored in `sessionStorage` on client as `adminToken`
- Passed via `x-admin-token` header on all admin requests

## Design System (DR Brand)
- **Font:** Inter Tight (Google Fonts) — weights 400/600/700/800
- **Colors:** Navy `#010F37`, Lime `#D5DE23`, Blue `#26A9E1`, Orange `#F6931E`, Gray `#404041`

- **Primary CTA:** Lime pill buttons (`#D5DE23` bg, `#010F37` text, `border-radius: 999px`)
- **Cards:** White surface, lime top-border (`border-top: 3px solid #D5DE23`)
- **Table header:** Navy bg with white text
- **Toast:** Navy pill with lime left-border accent
- **Dark mode:** Navy grid texture background, dark surfaces (`#0c1840`)

## Railway Setup
- **Port:** 8080 (set via PORT env variable)
- **Volume:** `/app/data` — single volume covering DB + uploads
- **Custom domain:** `signatures.yourdigitalresource.com`
  - CNAME: `signatures` → (Railway-assigned value, currently working — do NOT change)
  - TXT: `_railway-verify.signatures` → railway-verify token
- **Plan:** Free trial ($5 credit, ~20 days) — needs upgrade to Hobby ($5/month) before trial expires or app goes offline

## Migration History
- Originally hosted on Hostinger VPS at `76.13.127.140:3001` (Docker/docker-compose)
- Migrated to Railway via temporary HTTP endpoint pattern
- Data: VPS → tar → scp to local Mac → curl upload to Railway endpoint → redeploy
- Uploads path moved from `./uploads` to `./data/uploads` to fit single Railway volume

## Current Status (as of 2026-04-06)
- ✅ App live on Railway at production URL
- ✅ DR brand redesign deployed (index, edit, signature pages)
- ✅ New DR dark mode logo in use
- ⏳ Custom domain `signatures.yourdigitalresource.com` — DNS correct, SSL provisioning pending (Railway incident on 2026-04-06 may have delayed it; working via old CNAME, do not change DNS)
- ⚠️ Free trial expires in ~20 days — upgrade to Hobby plan ($5/month) needed

## Comparison vs NewOldStamp (90-sig plan)
- NewOldStamp 90-signature plan: $1,439/month ($17,268/year)
- This app: $5/month on Railway
- Annual savings: ~$17,208
- Key differentiator: employees self-serve via web app URL — no admin distribution bottleneck
- NewOldStamp advantage: can auto-push signatures into Gmail/Outlook via Google Workspace / M365 integration

## Admin Notes
- Admin password is stored in the DB settings table
- To change password: log in as admin → (no UI yet for this — would need direct DB edit or new feature)
- `node_modules/better-sqlite3` must be rebuilt if Node.js version changes: `npm rebuild better-sqlite3`

- **Custom domain:** https://signatures.yourdigitalresource.com (DNS correct, SSL provisioned)
- **Local dev:** http://localhost:3000

## Stack
- Node.js + Express + SQLite (better-sqlite3) + Multer
- Vanilla JS only — no frameworks, no over-engineering
- Railway PaaS, persistent volume at `/app/data` (covers DB + uploads)
- Auto-deploys from GitHub on push to main

## Key Files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `server.js` | Express server, all API routes, DB setup |
| `public/index.html` | Dashboard — employee list, master template, admin auth |
| `public/edit.html` | Split-pane signature editor |
| `public/signature.html` | Employee page to copy their signature |
| `public/sig-builder.js` | Shared signature HTML builder |
| `public/dr-logo.png` | DR dark mode logo (clicking always goes to `/`) |
| `data/signatures.db` | SQLite database |
| `data/uploads/` | Uploaded images |

## DR Brand System (applied to all 3 pages)
- **Font:** Inter Tight (Google Fonts) — 400/600/700/800
- **Colors:** Navy `#010F37`, Lime `#D5DE23`, Blue `#26A9E1`, Orange `#F6931E`, Gray `#404041`
- **Logo:** `/dr-logo.png` — links to `/` on all pages
- **Light mode default** + dark mode toggle (localStorage key: `dr-theme`)
- **Primary buttons:** Lime pill (`#D5DE23` bg, `#010F37` text, `border-radius: 999px`)
- **Cards:** White surface + `border-top: 3px solid #D5DE23`
- **Table header:** Navy bg, white text
- **Dark mode:** Navy grid texture, dark surfaces `#0c1840`

## Railway Setup
- Port: 8080
- Volume: `/app/data`
- Custom domain CNAME is working — do NOT change DNS records
- **Hobby plan ($5/month)** — upgrade from free trial was needed to keep app online

## Auth
- Admin password in SQLite settings table (key: `admin_password`)
- In-memory sessions via `adminSessions` Set in server.js
- Client stores token in `sessionStorage` as `adminToken`
- Passed via `x-admin-token` header

## Important Rules
- Never change JavaScript logic — CSS and HTML structure only for design changes
- `better-sqlite3` needs rebuild if Node version changes: `npm rebuild better-sqlite3`
- Single Railway volume constraint: uploads must stay inside `data/` directory
